listening.title: At the Hotel (A1)
listening.audio_script:
Receptionist: Hello. What is your name?
Guest: My name is Anna. A-N-N-A.
Receptionist: Where are you from?
Guest: I am from Italy.
Receptionist: What is your room number?
Guest: Room five. Number five.
listening.question: What is the guest's name?

listening.title: Train Announcement (A2)
listening.audio_script: Announcement: The train to Manchester leaves from platform four at ten fifteen. Please have your tickets ready. The journey takes two hours. Food and drinks are available in carriage three.
listening.question: Which platform does the train leave from?

listening.title: Travel Experience (B1)
listening.audio_script:
Host: Today we talk about travel. Have you ever missed a flight?
Guest: Yes, last year I was travelling to Scotland. My train was delayed due to heavy snow, so I arrived at the airport 20 minutes after departure.
listening.question: Why did the guest miss the flight?

listening.title: Urbanisation Lecture (B2)
listening.audio_script: Lecturer: Urbanisation is not simply people moving to cities. In developing nations, this transition is occurring at unprecedented speeds — taking roughly three decades compared to the century-long process observed in Europe.
listening.question: What point does the lecturer emphasize regarding developing nations?
options: Urbanisation is slower than in Europe
Same speed as in European history
Much faster — 3 decades vs a century
listening.answer: Much faster — 3 decades vs a century

listening.title: AI Debate Discussion (C1)
listening.audio_script:
Moderator: Should we anthropomorphise AI?
Panellist 1: We already do — and that's precisely the danger. Users easily infer empathy and intentionality where there is merely sophisticated statistical pattern matching.
listening.question: According to Panellist 1, what risk arises when people anthropomorphise AI?
options: Users infer empathy where only pattern matching exists
listening.answer: Users infer empathy where only pattern matching exists

writing.prompt: Describe a difficult challenge or memorable experience you had recently. Explain what happened, how you dealt with it, and what you learned from it. (Write 60 - 120 words)
Many companies now permit employees to work from anywhere. Do you believe remote work is better than working in a traditional office? Give reasons and examples. (Write 60 - 120 words)
Artificial intelligence and digital tools are transforming how students learn. Discuss one benefit and one potential downside of using AI in classrooms. (Write 60 - 120 words)
Write about a trip or journey that made a strong impression on you. Where did you go, who were you with, and why was it memorable? (Write 60 - 120 words)

speaking.prompt: Speak for 60 to 90 seconds: Introduce yourself briefly, and describe a personal goal you are currently working towards. Why is this goal meaningful to you?
Speak for 60 to 90 seconds: Talk about a time when something did not go as planned. How did you react, what steps did you take to fix it, and what was the outcome?
Speak for 60 to 90 seconds: Describe your hometown or city to someone who has never been there. Highlight a tradition, landmark, or food that makes it unique.
Speak for 60 to 90 seconds: Which modern device or application can you not live without? Explain how it shapes your daily productivity and lifestyle.
